mapper.select: SELECT child.* FROM ip_investment_pool child INNER JOIN ip_investment_pool parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id AND parent.is_deleted = 0 WHERE child.is_deleted = 0 AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.variety_codes LIKE '%"fund"%' AND parent.pool_name = #{parentPoolName} AND child.pool_name = #{childPoolName} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool descendant WHERE descendant.parent_id = child.id AND descendant.is_deleted = 0 AND descendant.status = 'enabled' )

SELECT status.fund_code ,fund.fund_name ,fund.fund_short_name ,fund.security_type FROM ip_pool_status_fund status LEFT JOIN rrs_fundinfo fund ON fund.fund_code = status.fund_code AND fund.is_deleted = 0 WHERE status.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND status.audit_status = '20' AND status.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY status.fund_code ASC
